name: Otter Tale
source:
You're on your way to otter tale island for a bit of a reprieve after that mess in college.

Mom said it'd be good for you.

Dad said you need to go back to your roots.

You just want to get away from all this.

[From [url=https://ottertheotter.itch.io/otter-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经历大学里那场混乱后，你正前往水獭传说岛，暂时喘口气。

妈妈说，这对你有好处。

爸爸说，你得回归自己的根。

你只想逃离这一切。

[摘自[url=https://ottertheotter.itch.io/otter-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
